title: Isithsaba Esasichasa Isibhakabhaka
intro: Kwiindlela zobukumkani bamandulo, igama lomlawuli omnye laba yintsingiselo yobuzwilakhe kunye nokuzikhukhumeza. Xa umkhonzi othobekileyo ka-Allah efika ephethe imiqondiso engenakuphikiswa, lo mlawuli unamandla wala ukuzinikela enyanisweni. Namhlanje, umsebenzi wakho kukuchonga lo mntu udumileyo olawulo lwakhe lwadilika kwaye ikamva lakhe lavalwa phantsi kwamaza.
clues: Ndingumlawuli owoyikwa kakhulu ogama lakhe lisavakala njengesilumkiso ukutyhubela iminyaka.
Ndayalela abantu bonke ukuba basebenze ngamatyathanga, bephakamisa izikhumbuzo ezazivakalisa uzuko lwam.
Xa isithunywa sika-Allah safika phambi kwam sinemiqondiso engenakuphikwa, ndala ukuqubuda ndaza ndathi bubugqwirha.
Ndayalela ukuba kubulawe oonyana abancinane phakathi kwabantu abathinjiweyo, ndinethemba lokubatyumza umoya wabo ngaphambi kokuba bavuke.
Ndema phambi kwenkundla yam ndaza ndathi, 'Ndiyinkosi yenu ephezulu,' ndifuna ukunqulwa njengothixo.
Ndikunye nomphathiswa wam oyintloko ecaleni kwam, ndakha isakhiwo eside esijolise ekunyukeni ngaphaya kwamazulu.
verse: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed. (79:17)
